title: Presigned upload URLs for object storage
tasks: presigned upload urls for object storage

requirements.text: The server issues a presigned upload URL only to an authorized user, for a server-generated key under that tenant's prefix
The signature binds the content type and maximum size (for example a POST policy content-length-range)
URLs expire within minutes and allow writing exactly one object
After upload the server confirms the object and checks size, type and checksum before marking the file ready
Storage credentials never reach the client; the bucket is private and CORS allows only the app origin
Abandoned uploads and pending file records are cleaned up
Downloads use short-lived presigned GET URLs issued after an authorization check

implementations.notes: Direct-to-S3 upload library with a server router

notes: No Genlib S3 presigning. signed-urls signs expiring HMAC URLs for the app's own server, not object-storage SigV4; resumable-files covers tus uploads instead.
